abstract: As artificial intelligence becomes integral to critical infrastructure, organizations face unprecedented cybersecurity challenges that demand specialized expertise. This keynote introduces SEC411: Managing AI Cybersecurity Risk, SANS Institute's groundbreaking course designed specifically for security professionals navigating the complex intersection of AI and cybersecurity. Drawing from real-world incidents and emerging threat patterns, we'll explore how AI systems create novel attack surfaces—from data poisoning to model inversion attacks—that traditional security frameworks cannot adequately address. Through compelling case studies and practical frameworks, attendees will learn to identify AI-specific vulnerabilities, implement robust model governance, and develop incident response strategies tailored for machine learning environments. The presentation will feature live demonstrations of AI attack vectors and defensive countermeasures, providing hands-on insights into protecting AI assets across the enterprise. Whether you're securing AI-powered applications, defending against adversarial ML attacks, or building AI security programs from scratch, this session delivers immediately applicable knowledge and tools. We'll examine how leading organizations are integrating AI security into their broader risk management strategies, establishing governance frameworks, and measuring AI-related security posture. The session concludes with a roadmap for advancing your AI security career through SANS' comprehensive curriculum, including hands-on labs, expert mentorship, and industry networking opportunities. Join us as we chart the course for securing our AI-driven future.
elevator_pitch: Discover how to protect your organization from emerging AI-specific cyber threats with SANS' new SEC411 course. Learn practical frameworks for securing machine learning systems, defending against adversarial attacks, and building robust AI governance programs.
learning_objectives: Identify and classify 12+ unique AI attack vectors including data poisoning, model inversion, and adversarial examples
Implement practical frameworks for AI model governance, risk assessment, and incident response
Conduct hands-on vulnerability assessments of AI/ML systems using industry-standard methodologies
Develop actionable AI security strategies aligned with organizational risk tolerance and compliance requirements
target_audience: Security architects, cybersecurity analysts, risk managers, compliance officers, and IT leaders responsible for AI/ML system security. Mid to senior-level professionals with 3+ years security experience. Chief Information Security Officers, AI ethics officers, and security program managers implementing AI governance frameworks.
prerequisites: Basic understanding of cybersecurity principles and familiarity with machine learning concepts. Experience with cloud platforms and data security practices recommended. Fundamental knowledge of neural networks and deep learning architectures beneficial but not required.

speaker_bio: Michael Moran brings over 15 years of cybersecurity leadership experience, specializing in emerging technology risk management. As Senior Security Strategist at SANS Institute, he develops cutting-edge curricula addressing AI security, quantum computing threats, and next-generation attack surfaces. Michael has led security transformations for Fortune 500 enterprises and government agencies, consistently bridging the gap between emerging technology and practical security implementation. His expertise spans AI/ML security architecture, threat intelligence, and security operations center design. Michael holds CISSP, CISA, and multiple SANS certifications, and regularly speaks at premier security conferences worldwide. He serves on the board of several cybersecurity nonprofits and contributes to NIST AI Risk Management Framework development.
previous_experience: Delivered keynote presentations at RSA Conference (2022, 2023), Black Hat USA (2021, 2022), and OWASP Global Summit (2023). Featured speaker in SANS Webinars series with 10,000+ cumulative views. Presented 'Securing the Intelligent Enterprise' at Gartner Security & Risk Management Summit (2023). Regular contributor to IEEE Security & Privacy magazine and co-author of 'AI Security Operations' whitepaper series. Hosted SANS AI Security podcast with 500,000+ downloads.
